  • Trump-Xi-Putin meeting is important for stability, analyst says
    Just now23m ago

    Today’s trilateral meeting between Xi, Trump and Putin could lay the groundwork for relatively stable relations between the three nuclear powers, the precursor for cooperation on thornier issues such as AI, said Fred Gao, a nonresident research fellow at the Beijing-based Center for China and Globalization.

  • Shenzhen has the world's second-highest number of billionaires after New York
    Just now1h ago

    Shenzhen, the city hosting this week’s APEC summit, has the highest number of billionaires in all of China: 132, up 47 from last year, according to this year’s Hurun China Rich List, an annual ranking compiled by a private Shanghai-based company. Shanghai came in second, followed by Beijing.
